state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: For books, the paper decomposes algorithmically: text short enough is summarised directly, longer text is chunked and each chunk recursively summarised, giving a tree where only leaf tasks operate on original book text. Height-0 tasks summarise book text, tasks of height above 0 are composition tasks over concatenated summaries, and the depth-0 task produces the whole-book summary from depth-1 summaries.
title: Fixed algorithmic chunking into a tree of summarization tasks with height and depth
